items.text: Arizona: Gardner Minshew named the Week 9 starter over Jacoby Brissett (Carson Beck QB2). RB Jeremiyah Love (high ankle sprain) going on IR; WR Kendrick Bourne (fractured tibia) likely out for the season. TBD: RB Bam Knight (concussion), WR Michael Wilson (ribs), OT Jayden Williams (knee). OT Paris Johnson Jr. and RB James Conner out.

Seattle (TBD): LT Charles Cross (high ankle sprain), WR Rashid Shaheed (knee), DT Leonard Williams (shoulder), EDGE Uchenna Nwosu (ankle), RB Velus Jones Jr. (hamstring). TE Elijah Arroyo out for season. G Quenton Nelson acquired from IND.
